description: Check if a URL is a known phishing site in the PhishTank database. Returns whether it is a phish, verification status, and details URL. Example: check_url("http://suspicious-site.example.com/login").

url.description: The full URL to check for phishing (e.g., "http://example.com/fake-login")

name: check_url

checked_at.description: ISO timestamp when the URL was checked by PhishTank API

detail_page.description: URL to PhishTank detail page, or null if not in database

in_database.description: Whether the URL is in the PhishTank database

is_phish.description: Whether the URL is confirmed as a phishing site

phish_id.description: PhishTank ID for the phishing entry, or null if not in database

verified.description: Whether the phishing entry has been verified, or null if unknown

verified_at.description: Timestamp when the phishing entry was verified, or null if unverified

title: Check Url
